export type IconType = 'cloud' | 'moon-cloud' | 'rain' | 'partly-cloudy';

type Forecast = {
  time: Date;
  temperature: number;
  precipitation: number;
  maxPrecipitation: number;
  wind: number;
  gust: number;
  icon: IconType;
  windDirection: number;
};
